roles.drugs: Curettage and electrodesiccation, cryosurgery, topical imiquimod or 5-fluorouracil, photodynamic therapy; radiation as adjunct or for nonsurgical candidates. Topicals are supported for cSCC in situ (Bowen) but not FDA-approved (AAFP)
